scenes.heading: Building repeat business through maintenance plans and reminders

sents.d: Building repeat business through maintenance plans and reminders
Recurring revenue is usually more valuable than constantly chasing one-off jobs.

Many local services have a natural recurring need (regular cleaning, seasonal lawn care, periodic maintenance) — packaging this into a subscription or maintenance plan converts one-time customers into recurring revenue.

Proactively reaching out when a customer's typical service interval is approaching, rather than waiting for them to remember and reach out, captures repeat business that would otherwise be lost to simple forgetfulness.
Offering a modest discount for committing to a recurring schedule, compared to booking each job individually, incentivizes the more stable, predictable revenue that benefits your own planning.

take: Package recurring service into a plan and remind customers on time.
